text:
Marta (Marketing): Quick sync 44b final pass on landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need hero, micro-benchmark line, webinar CTA, and inbound routing rules.

Sam (Growth): Two CTAs: "Start Hosted free" (self-serve) and "Request Dedicated/Private demo" (sales). Hero one-liner <=12 words.

Anya (UX): Headline options:
- "Production LLM inference, one API."
- "Ship reliable LLM features with predictable cost."
Subhead: "Hosted, Dedicated, Private 1 API & SLAs." CTA microcopy: "Start free" / "Book demo".

Leo (Product): Benchmark for hero: "Production-profiled 1 up to 1.2M tokens/sec; ~30% lower per-token cost." Dedicated bullets: "Reserved GPU pools 4bb configurable autoscale 52c SLA-backed latency targets." Private bullets: "VPC & on-prem 4f6 KMS/HSM 512 audit logs."

Marta (Marketing): Webinar CTA short: "Live launch demo & Q&A". Longer promo: "45-min walkthrough showing Hosted, Dedicated, Private in real workloads."

Priya (Growth Ops): Routing rules draft: deployment_interest values: hosted,dedicated,private. If deployment != hosted OR company_size>250 -> route to #leads-enterprise + SF Tier=Enterprise. Else -> #leads-self-serve + tag utm_campaign=hosted-try. Webinar registrants -> tag webinar:launch-2; if size>100 assign AE follow-up. Required fields: name,email,company,size,use_case,consent. Slack webhook sends email,name,company,size,use_case,utm.

Sam (Growth): Add gate: if email domain is major cloud vendor or competitor -> route to #growth-review for manual triage.

Anya (UX): A/B plan: Variant A shows stat block under hero; Variant B leads with developer value. Keep CTAs identical.

deploy-bot: "Reminder: merge marketing-site branch by EOD Thu to hit launch. CI: 2 failing tests." :warning:

Marta (Marketing): Action items: Anya finalize A/B copy; Leo confirm benchmark sentence and bullets; Priya ship webhook spec and SF queues; Sam draft webinar email series. I'll lock Variant A (stat-first) tomorrow unless issues. Will post staging URL here once up.

Sam (Growth): 👍 on email draft by 11am tomorrow.

Anya (UX): 👍 on copy variants.

Priya (Growth Ops): 👍 starting webhook doc and queues now.
